Hey Ali,

It's been a while since we spoke about the AI outreach engine for Ephlux. I'm revisiting our old conversation and wanted to check back in.

Since then, we've improved the system quite a bit. The core idea is still the same — finding the right companies, researching them, and starting relevant conversations, only when it makes sense.

I've linked the process overview again in case it's useful:
https://www.loom.com/share/66b3d9799bf6409fb25f45ef88dec54c

Is filling the pipeline something Ephlux is thinking about right now? If so, I'd love a quick 10-minute call to see if it fits.
drafts.reason_hr: Stara konverzacija (314 dana), Ali je tražio video koji je poslan. Kratko priznanje dugog vremena, podsjećanje na AI outbound proces, davanje linka za video i poziv na kratki poziv. Nema lažnih izgovora, nema obećanja novih stvari.
